author: yungmuck
body: OK hello I was just banned a minute ago for the most absolute dumbest thing ever. I was accused of combat logging and was banned for it I find this very frustrating and quite frankely I'm mad about it. fix this please and thank you

title: Un-Ban

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Uh... our console detects combat logging. As the appellate, I have more confidence in the respondent and their judgement in this field of banning. If you have any evidence proving you otherwise, hit me up with another appeal and I'll review it.

Also pal, it's a one day ban, chill.
